create.partial: Adventure created, but {{count}} item(s) could not be saved.
create.title: New adventure
create.locationsIntro: Each location can carry a map / illustration and a GM-only description. Tick “Hidden” to hide it from the players in session.
create.enemiesIntro: Pick from the classic monsters or create a custom enemy. An enemy is a type; numbers are chosen in combat.
create.npcsIntro: Allies, quest givers, antagonists… Name, personality and lore, linkable to a location.
create.pitchLead: A title, and a few lines to remember the plot.
create.pitchWhy: Players see the title once they take part; the summary is a reminder for you. Everything can be changed later from the adventure page.
create.locationsWhy: In a session you show a place in one click: its map appears on every player's screen. A hidden place is uncovered from under the fog, with the brush.
create.enemiesWhy: Prepared here, enemies join a fight in a few clicks, with their HP, AC and attacks.
create.npcsWhy: Keep everyone's temper and secrets at hand. “Add to the codex” turns one into an entry the players will discover.
create.reviewLead: One last look before creating the adventure.
create.reviewWhy: Nothing is set in stone: places, enemies and NPCs are added and edited later from the adventure page.
create.startTitle: How do you want to start?
create.startLead: A brand new adventure, or one already prepared, in a file.
create.startWhy: An adventure file (.json) brings its locations, enemies, NPCs and highlights. It comes from another adventure's export, or is written by hand following the guide. Every following screen is pre-filled: review, adjust, then create.
create.blankHint: You prepare locations, enemies and NPCs on the next screens.
create.importFileHint: From an adventure file (.json): exported from another campaign, or written by hand.
create.importNeeded: Choose a valid adventure file, or start from scratch.
create.missingPack: This adventure uses the pack “{{name}}”, not allowed in the campaign: its monsters are imported without their reference entry.

detail.loadFailed: Could not load this adventure. Check your connection and try again.
detail.busy: First end the adventure “{{title}}” before starting another one.
detail.draftNotPlayable: A draft adventure can't be played.
detail.cannotReturnToDraft: An adventure already played can't go back to draft.
detail.alreadyActive: “{{title}}” is already in progress. End it before starting another one.
detail.notParticipant: You are not taking part in this adventure.
detail.notYet: The rest of the adventure (locations, enemies, NPCs) opens during a live session, then once the adventure is completed.
detail.draftHint: Draft: invisible to players, not playable. Set it to “Upcoming” or “In progress” to start a session.
detail.conditionsHint: You assign conditions (poisoned, prone…) and exhaustion to each participant from the session; players see them read-only. Off, nothing shows on the player side.
detail.deleteDescription: Permanently removes this adventure and its content.
detail.deleteDisabled: End the current session before deleting the adventure.
detail.deleteConfirm: This cannot be undone: the associated locations, enemies, NPCs and participants will be lost.

enemies.title: Enemies
enemies.intro: An enemy is a type. Numbers (and instances 1, 2, 3…) are chosen when a fight starts.
enemies.name: Name

locations.scaleHint: Click two points whose distance you know (a square, a wall…), then enter it.
locations.scalePickA: Click the first point on the map.
locations.title: Locations
locations.name: Name
locations.hiddenHint: In session, the location appears fully hidden to players. The GM reveals the map bit by bit with the eraser.
locations.addFirst: Add a location first to be able to link one.
locations.intro: Each location can carry a map / illustration and a GM-only description. Tick “Hidden” to hide it from the players in session.

npcs.title: Characters (NPCs)
npcs.name: Name
npcs.personalityPlaceholder: Wary, greedy, loyal to the baron…
npcs.lorePlaceholder: Backstory, role in the plot, secrets…
npcs.intro: Allies, quest givers, antagonists… Name, personality and lore, linkable to a location.
npcs.combatProfileHint: With a profile, the NPC can join a fight as a party ally, under its own name.

participants.title: Participants
participants.addPlayer: Add a player, with the character of your choice
participants.othersMustPick: The other members must first choose a character (campaign page).

chronicle.title: Chronicle
chronicle.intro: The adventure told session by session, by your GM.
chronicle.introGm: Every ended session, in order. Write its recap then publish it: players only see published recaps.
chronicle.emptyGm: No ended session yet. The recap is written once the session is over.
chronicle.heading: Session {{number}}
chronicle.noRecap: This session's recap is coming soon.
chronicle.noRecapGm: No recap published for this session yet.
chronicle.notebookEmpty: Nothing to note for this session.
chronicle.toWriteHint: Players cannot see this session yet. The editor starts from the notebook's facts.
chronicle.recapPending: The GM is still writing the recap of session {{number}}.

recap.draftHint: Draft only you can see. Publish it so players read it in the chronicle.
recap.publishedHint: This recap is published. Your changes stay a draft until “Update”.
recap.title: Title (optional)
recap.gmNotesPlaceholder: What they didn't see, threads to pick up…
recap.gmNotesHint: Never shown to players, even once published.
recap.published: Recap published: players can read it.

events.title: Events
events.intro: The key moments you plan, in order. You reveal them during a session; players then find them in the chronicle.
events.name: Title
events.triggerPlaceholder: When the party crosses the river
events.descriptionHint: It shows in the chronicle once the event is revealed: keep secrets in your notes.
events.dueHint: On the game clock: a day, a time, or both. In a session, when you move the clock there, the panel tells you “it's time”; you reveal it.

journal.title: Characters' journals
journal.dialogHint: Tell the session from your character's point of view. Shared with the party, the entry shows here; it always stays in your character's journal.

start.title: Adventure start
start.timeInvalid: Write the time as HH:MM, e.g. 21:00.
start.hint: The first session's clock starts here. Later sessions resume where the previous one stopped.
start.hintPlayed: Already played: the next sessions resume the last one's time. This only counts for an adventure that hasn't started yet.

realtime.title: Start with a realtime server
realtime.intro: Tokens, HP and the fight go through your server: they move continuously for everyone, with no Firestore writes. The rest (location, clock, fog, sheets) stays in Firestore.
realtime.ko: No Adventure Keeper server at this address.
realtime.mixed: The site is on https: the server must be too.
realtime.localAsk: Is Adventure Keeper Serveur running on this computer?
realtime.localNone: No server found: launch Adventure Keeper Serveur, wait for “Server ready”, then try again.
realtime.localInUse: Adventure Keeper Serveur's address, on this computer.
realtime.local: Adventure Keeper Serveur is running on this computer.
realtime.hint: No server? <download>Adventure Keeper Serveur</download> runs one on your computer. The address is remembered on this device for the campaign.

plannedLoot.title: Planned loot
plannedLoot.hint: What the GM can hand out in a session, in one tap, from “Give loot”.
